description: Tremolo whose pulse width narrows AFTER each envelope peak of the material itself ('TREMOLO A SOUND, WIDTH NARROWED, AFTER PEAK'): the program extracts the source's amplitude envelope at winsize resolution and drives the tremolo's fineness-squeeze from where the sound sits relative to its own peaks - sustained material gets progressively narrower, more agitated pulsing as it decays. Distinct render from the tremolo program at identical frq/depth/fineness (verified: different sha, similar RMS range). NO TIME-VARIABLE PARAMETERS: all four positional params refuse breakpoint files (parameters 1-4 verbatim) - unlike its sibling tremolo, where frq/depth/gain all ride breakpoints; there is also no gain slot. Duration static and exact at both probed input durations; deterministic; stereo accepted.
musical_use: Envelope-aware tremolo: because the narrowing follows the SOURCE's own dynamic contour, decaying notes flutter more as they die - an organic, bowed-tremolo/flatterzunge quality that plain fixed tremolo lacks. Best on material with clear envelope shape (plucked/struck notes, speech, swells); on flat beds it approximates ordinary tremolo. winsize is the sensitivity control: small (1-5 ms) reacts to every micro-transient, large (20-40 ms) follows only the note-level contour. Use tremolo (curated sibling) when you need breakpoint control, a gain ride, or exact reproducibility of envel tremolo; use tremenv when the material should modulate itself. Scalar-only params make this a set-and-render effect - vary it across takes with sweep() rather than within one file.

frq.description: Tremolo rate, 0-500 Hz (banner range; same slot convention as tremolo). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 1 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.'). Scalar only.

depth.description: Tremolo depth 0-1. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 2'). Scalar only.

winsize.description: Envelope-extraction window driving the after-peak narrowing. CDP-enforced 1-40 ms ('Parameter[3] Value (50.000000) out of range (1.000000 to 40.000000)'; 0.5 refused the same way). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 3'). Scalar only.

fineness.description: Squeeze width of the tremolo pulses (as in the tremolo program). CDP-enforced 1-100 ('Parameter[4] Value (101.000000) out of range (1.000000 to 100.000000)'). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 4'). Scalar only.

examples.description: Decay-flutter on struck or plucked material.
examples.expected_use: Notes pulse harder and narrower as they die away; envelope followed at 20 ms resolution.
Tight windows make the narrowing chase every transient - nervous, speech-like flutter.

known_issues: NO time-variable parameters: every slot refuses breakpoints (parameters 1-4 verbatim) - the envelope-following IS the time variation. For breakpoint-driven tremolo use the curated tremolo entry.
No gain parameter (unlike tremolo); stage level before or after.
Renders differently from tremolo at identical settings (sha-verified) - they are not interchangeable, the narrowing schedule differs by construction.
Deterministic; duration static and exact at both probed input durations; stereo accepted (2-channel output).
